notes: τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ → 'therein': the preposition and pronoun form one aligned unit headed on the pronominal and the article stands alone as unrepresented (rules 81, 93).
χειροποιήτοις is headed on 'made', the compound's head element, as rule 66 heads ἀρχιερεύς on 'priest'; 'hands' is the competing reading.
